description.html: JLab Epic Mini Wireless Keyboard is a 60% form factor wireless keyboard built for work and compact desk setups. It connects via 2.4GHz USB-C dongle or Bluetooth 5.2, runs on battery for over a year between charges, and supports both Windows and Mac layouts in one keyboard. 82 keys with a media knob in a compact, portable package. A 60% layout removes the numpad, function row, and navigation cluster found on full-size keyboards, leaving only the core alphanumeric keys, modifier keys, and arrow cluster - the keys used most during typing. The result is a noticeably smaller footprint on your desk and a lighter keyboard to carry, while a media knob at the top right handles volume and media control without needing the missing function row. OS Layout Keys let you switch between Windows and Mac key configurations directly on the keyboard. Scissor switches provide a low-profile keypress with 1.8mm stroke distance and 5 million cycle key life - quiet and well suited for shared workspaces. Backlit keys for low-light use. Battery life runs over 1 year with the backlight off and over 13 days with backlight at max. Standby time exceeds 24 months. Charges via USB-C in under 5 hours. Connect via 2.4GHz USB-C dongle for stable low-latency wireless or Bluetooth 5.2 for multi-device flexibility. Tilt legs for adjustable typing angle. Coated ABS top cover. ABS keycaps. The JLab Work app handles saved profiles and custom key configuration. Includes Epic Mini Keyboard, USB-C dongle, and a JLab 2-year limited warranty. The GO Wireless Mouse Black is a compact wireless mouse built to switch between a Windows PC, Mac, or Chrome OS device without re-pairing each time. It ships in a single black colorway. The mouse uses Bluetooth multipoint to stay paired to two devices at once and switches between them with a button press, letting one mouse serve a laptop and a phone side by side without disconnecting and reconnecting. The mouse runs on a single AA battery rather than a built-in rechargeable cell, so power can be swapped out on the go instead of waiting on a charge. Connectivity is dual mode: a 2.4GHz USB-A wireless dongle handles one connection for the most stable link, while Bluetooth 5.0 pairs directly to a second device without the dongle plugged in. Polling rate differs by connection type, 125Hz over 2.4GHz and 115Hz over Bluetooth. The mouse works with Windows 10 or later, macOS 10.15 or later, Chrome OS, and Microsoft Surface devices. The mouse has an ambidextrous shape for either hand and measures 3.9 inches tall, 2.52 inches long, and 1.54 inches wide, weighing 58.4 grams total. It has 4 buttons, an optical sensor rated at 3000 frames per second, and a maximum tracking speed of 28 inches per second. DPI is adjustable across three settings: 800, 1200, and 1600. Clicks are silent, with a button force of 100 grams (± 10g) and a scroll wheel force of 20 grams (± 5g). Includes: the GO Wireless Mouse, 1 AA battery, a USB-A wireless dongle, and a JLab 2 year limited warranty.
